# outputs/maps/ — Map Collections

Base maps and thematic map sets (SST, wind, heat flux, ENSO/IOD/MEI overlays) used for inspection and figures.

## On-disk layout

```
outputs/maps/maps/
├── base/
├── sst/ wind/ heat_flux/
├── enso/ iod/ mei/
```

## Generated by

Map-producing scripts under `src/climate/scripts/` using helpers in `src/climate/plotting/bob_map.py` (plus year processing / driver scripts as applicable).

## Upstream / Downstream

Raw/merged fields + plotting helpers → reusable map assets → yearly folders / publication / presentations.

## Notes

SST analysis boxes (15/10°N splits at 85–95°E) differ from red **map display** lines (18/12°N) — see `src/climate/plotting/README.md`.
